stem: Object access patterns for a dataset change unpredictably month to month, and the team wants no retrieval fee ever charged regardless of how access changes, while still lowering cost compared with S3 Standard once objects go cold. Select TWO accurate statements. (Select TWO.)

choices.text: S3 Intelligent-Tiering monitors access and moves objects between tiers automatically with no retrieval fee
S3 Standard-IA never charges a retrieval fee regardless of access pattern
S3 One Zone-IA automatically adapts its tier to changing access patterns
Glacier Instant Retrieval has no minimum storage duration commitment
S3 Intelligent-Tiering charges a small monitoring fee per object in exchange for that flexibility

rationale: S3 Intelligent-Tiering monitors access and moves objects between its tiers automatically, and it never charges a retrieval fee no matter how the access pattern changes. In exchange for that flexibility, Intelligent-Tiering charges a small monitoring fee per object, the tradeoff the team accepts for not having to predict the access pattern. S3 Standard-IA does charge a retrieval fee; it is priced for infrequent but predictable access, not an unpredictable pattern with no retrieval charge. One Zone-IA is a fixed storage class that does not monitor or adapt to changing access on its own. Glacier Instant Retrieval carries a 90-day minimum storage duration, so it is not free of a minimum-duration commitment.
